verdict.rationale: Anytype stores content locally in an encrypted Vault and says that not even Anytype can see your content, which structurally keeps your data away from vendor model training. Local-only mode and self-hosting let you remove Anytype's servers entirely, and the local API runs on localhost and offline. However, the evidence contains no explicit statement or policy about AI training. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party no-AI-training policy or opt-out, and independent verification that content never reaches third-party AI services.
